subtopic: Garbage Collection Mechanics and Memory Leak Profiling
question_text: In tracing garbage collection, how does the Tri-Color Marking algorithm classify an object marked 'Gray'?

options.text: The object is unreachable and eligible for immediate collection
The object is reachable, but its referenced outgoing child objects have not yet been scanned
The object has been scanned and all its references are verified live
The object resides in an off-heap direct buffer

answer_explanation: White = unvisited candidate for deletion; Gray = visited/live, but children pending scan; Black = visited/live, and all referenced children have been identified.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: White = unvisited candidate for deletion; Gray = visited/live, but children pending scan; Black = visited/live, and all referenced children have been identified.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Selects the exact correct technical option.
